## ppwr-rule-engine

A pure function. Submission, item and ruleset in; findings and a summary out.

No database, no HTTP, no model, no clock. Same inputs, same findings, same order, every time, which is why you defend a verdict a year later.

`now` is passed in, never read. Re-run an old submission with its stored `evaluated_at` and you get the original verdict, not a fresh judgement against today.

**The Code node is built** from `src/engine/` by `npm run bundle` and swapped in at deploy. Editing it here changes nothing that survives. Change `src/engine/`, run the tests, deploy.

**Why it is not built on the canvas.** It is an expression parser, three-valued logic and seven check types, with 489 unit tests behind it. None of that is testable inside a workflow, and a rule engine you cannot test is one you should not trust.
